profile_text.body:
Pegasystems Inc is a public company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker PEGA and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001013857. Its website describes it as a leading AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation, saying that organizations use it to automate workflows, personalize customer experiences, and modernize legacy systems. The company says it has served large organizations since 1983.

On its own account, Pega's AI work centers on governance and human oversight. The site says Pega AI is grounded in best practices with governance built in, and that its AI agents operate with context, compliance, and human oversight from the start, allowing customers to orchestrate an agentic workforce end to end. It describes Pega Platform as unifying AI for mission-critical work and Pega Blueprint as an AI-powered workspace that brings business and IT together, combining best practices and governance to move design-time work into production.

The available record adds little beyond the corporate profile. No lawsuits, no tracked products, and no MCP servers are listed for the company.
